title: Lightly Buttery Japanese Onion Chirashi
description: A high-protein Japanese dish featuring onion rings and served in a banana leaf, inspired by Kansai cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter the banana leaves and place them on a baking sheet.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked Japanese rice, dried seaweed, and soy sauce to the bowl and mix well.
Divide the rice mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a small rectangle.
Place a few slices of onion on top of each rice rectangle.
Fold the banana leaves over the onion and rice to form a papillote.
Bake the papillotes in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the papillotes from the oven and brush the tops with melted butter.
Serve the chirashi hot, garnished with additional soy sauce and seaweed if desired.
